comment: The table of the three tables of the typed family of test/fort/support/generator.ft: TYPES,
STORAGES and OPERATIONS. Each row takes one row out of one table: a type with no text is no
type, a storage class with no place is no storage class, and an operation with no text is no
operation, so the mutant compiles and the family loses the cells or the statements of that
row. The stage runs test/fort/owner/typed/count_test.ft, which prints the count of the cells,
the vocabulary size of each cell, the count of the cells of each operation and the count of
the functions of 0 to 3 operations; a row is caught when a line changes. Two rows stand for
each table, the first row and another one. The source is a support module of the tests, so
the build does nothing and the md5 guard reads the module. The table runs in the Linux VM
with the debug preset after `tools/vm build`.

stages.name: the count test of the typed family
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std -j 1 owner/typed/count_test

mutations.what: the type table loses its first row, the owning pointer
the type table loses the nested aggregate
the storage table loses its first row, the local
the storage table loses the global
the operation table loses its first row, the store of a fresh value
the operation table loses the move through a cast
